svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 176 x 220 mm from 2 mm aluminium sheet; round the corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.4 mm holes at the box's bosses: 80 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre across, 100 mm each side up and down (measure your box).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay the modules on it as the inset and step 5 show: microcontroller

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upper left, trip board below it, relays upper right, driver below,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: terminal strip along the bottom, 80 mm below centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each module's holes through the module; drill 3.2 mm for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M3 screws on 6 mm nylon standoffs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr both faces so no chip can short a module.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M4 x 10 self-tapping screws into the bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 0.5 mm; the plate sits on all four bosses.
